live.model: frozen M6-FT3000 earlier today + Typhon CPU classifier

telemetry.joint_torque_source: MuJoCo data.qfrc_actuator at arm DOF indices; simulated generalized actuator torques, not hardware sensors
telemetry.temperature_source: unavailable; no temperature sensor in simulation

command.source: policy target and requested/applied OSC commands, separate from measured state
command.target_format: baseline: primary xyz_m, rotation6d, gripper, second arm unused
command.units: 7 normalized OSC components: dx,dy,dz,rotation vector xyz,gripper; each in [-1,1]
